Professional introduction

Teacher, department head, author.

Mr. Kamulegeya Mubarak Kiggundu is a mathematics educator who has held Head of Department mathematics roles and has written a textbook on applied mathematics.

His 2025 book names teaching and leadership experience associated with Buddo Secondary School, Kibuli Secondary School and Lubiri Secondary School. These are not presented as current employers, and dates are being confirmed with him.
